XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: ABS

  • Device: ABS hydraulic unit

  • Fault: The ABS and ESP warning lights come on, the message 'Hill Holder not available' appears on the display and the ABS hydraulic pump continues to operate continuously, even when the ignition is off, causing the battery to discharge.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: C0020 (ABS pump motor control circuit - Error)

  • Cause: Faulty ABS hydraulic unit

• Intervention: Check the condition and correct functioning of the ABS hydraulic unit and, if necessary, replace it.

  • Procedure:

  • Note: Following replacement, adjustment was carried out using a self-diagnostic tester, followed by complete bleeding of the braking system
